title: Ide Yousuke Meijin no Shin Jissen Mahjong
native_title: 井出洋介名人の新実戦麻雀
overview:
Get better at mahjong every time you play!
Matches against a computer with a powerful thinking routine are as rich as the real thing. Every time you play, your skill powers up steadily!!

Strong support for improving at mahjong!
The original mahjong guidebook "A Guide to Improvement" is supervised by master Yousuke Ide. This one book thoroughly teaches the tricks to getting better at mahjong, from the basics to advanced play. A hand-open mode is also included for study. Making full use of it is the shortcut to improvement.

Read your opponents' habits!
Your opponents are 16 mahjong players full of personality. Their lines and actions are fully linked to their thinking routines! You can even deduce their hands and waiting tiles from the players' expressions and movements! See through your opponents' habits and gain the advantage in the match!

打つたびに麻雀がうまくなる！
強力な思考ルーチンを持つコンピュータとの対戦は、実戦なみの充実度。打つたびに、あなたの実力はぐんぐんパワーアップ！！

麻雀上達を強力にサポート！
オリジナルの麻雀解説書「上達への手引書」は、名人・井出洋介が監修。この一冊で、基礎から応用まで、麻雀がうまくなるコツをしっかりと伝授！また、研究用として手牌オープンモードを装備。どんどん活用するのが、上達への近道だ。

対戦相手のクセを読め！
個性あふれる16人の雀士たちが対戦相手。彼らのセリフやアクションは、思考ルーチンと完全にリンク！雀士の表情や動作から、手役や待ち牌を推理することも可能だ！対戦相手のクセを見抜いて、対局を有利に進めよう！
